name: Deprecation Notice
description: A notice for a sunsetting capability: what is going, when, what replaces it, and what callers must do.
prompt_template:
You are writing a deprecation notice for the service described by this spec.

{grounding_context}

Use ONLY the assertions above. Every claim must trace to one. If a required fact is absent, write '[not specified in spec]' rather than inventing it. Reproduce any assertion marked Tier 1 verbatim.

Produce these sections: what_is_deprecated, timeline, replacement, required_action.
